public.title: Counting Bits
public.description: Return an array of length n+1 whose entry at index i counts the set bits in the nonnegative integer i. n ranges from 0 to 2000. Include the count for zero.
hints: Removing the low bit leaves floor(i/2).
The removed bit contributes i modulo 2.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Reuse the count of the integer shifted right by one and add its low bit. O(n) time and output space.
